{{Quote|This is my prison. You want to help out, bust a few heads, fine: but you'll do things my way.|Playt|<ref name="Belsavis Welcome" />}}
'''Playt''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who served as warden of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] [[Belsavis prison|prison complex]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]] during the [[Galactic War]] until he was [[Death/Legends|killed]] at the hands of the group known as the [[Condemned]] during the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire's]] [[Invasion of Belsavis|attack]] on the world. After his death, he was succeeded by Assistant Warden [[Graal]].
